newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes weaker in sparse trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes weaker in sparse trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed slightly weaker at C$1.3447 (US$0.7437) on Wednesday from Tuesday's close at C$1.3440 (US$0.7441) in sparse trading, dealers said. * Trading was muted as U.S. Federal Reserve policy makers met in Washington. * Their decision to hold rates steady prompted the currency to weaken slightly.
Trading was heavier and choppy after the FOMC announcement as market players cleared out their positions, traders said.
The FOMC decision to hold rates was widely expected, but many analysts believe it is only a matter of time before interest rates creep higher to keep inflation in check.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar slipped to 1.2233 marks from 1.2252 marks on Tuesday but edged up to 91.65 yen from 91.06 yen on Tuesday.
